method: Both numbers were recomputed from the files on disk rather than read out of prose. (1) 278 was recomputed as the count of accord_pred == 'contradiction' in the released per-pair file gold_standard_accord_results.csv (299 rows). (2) 261 was recomputed by re-running the exact join that accord/differential/run_experiments.py performs -- gold_standard_accord_results.csv -> annotation_sample_300.csv (pair_id -> HADM_ID/drug/rule/sentences) -> accord_decontamination_audit.csv (weak_label) -- and counting weak_label == 'contradiction'; it was independently cross-checked by summing TP+FP over the per-group cells stored in results/accord/differential/exp1a_gold_error_rates_by_group.json, which is the operation that 'implies 261'. (3) The hypothesis in C28 -- that the gap is a difference in how the value 'ambiguous' is handled -- was tested by enumerating every filter and every threshold rule on accord_pred and accord_contra_prob and checking whether any of them yields 261. (4) The two columns were cross-tabulated to give the exact per-cell disagreement. (5) The measured weak-labeller and ACCORD confusion matrices were compared against the reconstructed ones printed in ch7 and ch8. No note text, HADM_ID, SUBJECT_ID or pair_id is written by this script.
